summary: Regression test after code-quality fixes on Velora Dry Fruits. Backend: 32/32 pytest passing (test_velora_api.py + test_products_admin.py). Frontend: PDP (pista-plain-roasted & almond-regular) load, single product-main-image, price and Usage Suggestions render as plain text (no HTML entities/tags — verified innerHTML === textContent). Homepage catalog renders 32 cards (featured + catalog), no console errors, keyword alias search filters correctly (badam→Almonds, elaichi→Cardamom shown as only visible catalog card). Cart: add works, persisted in localStorage (velora_cart_v2) after full page reload, drawer opens showing item + subtotal ₹1,250. Newsletter: POST /api/newsletter/subscribe → 200 OK, success state (data-testid=newsletter-success) visible. Admin: login with velora-admin-2026, Products tab lists 117 rows, inline price edit + save persists and re-renders correctly, stock toggle works with success toast, Subscribers tab loads. Cleaned test subscriber. No regressions detected.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductDetail.jsx L222 — usage now rendered as plain text via {product.usage}. Verified DOM innerHTML equals textContent, no HTML/entities leaking. Fix is correct and eliminates the XSS surface from dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
ProductsContext.jsx — console.error on API failure with static fallback is appropriate (site never breaks). No regressions.
CartContext.jsx — try/catch around localStorage read + write with console.warn is safe; will not break in private/Safari-quota scenarios. Cart persistence verified end-to-end.
Newsletter.jsx — network error path now console.warn + local cache. Happy path unaffected (verified 200 OK + success state render).
Backend tests read ADMIN_TOKEN from env with default 'velora-admin-2026' — matches /app/backend/.env; tests are portable.

Note (pre-existing, not in this scope): AdminProducts.jsx PriceCell dialog-edit stale-value bug from iteration_2 still present. Inline edit works correctly; only Add/Edit dialog save leaves stale row until reload.
